items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: And I was with Willy Pratt

ctx.x: And they said, we'll get him. And I was with Willy Pratt and I wasn't playing regular, because every time a __________ would come out, I'd have to sit back, I couldn't go on the stand. And I went over to Lunceford band, first time I heard it, they'd been trying to get me for about four years. Because when school would start, Paul Webster and Eddie would come back, because Paul was taking a mortician and Eddie was being a doctor. Eddie __________ went up to seven years --
